channel.title: The Argo: the house of 0x5fa0d75f
channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Alkon #4944 and Melmachos #1305 the Twice-Born fought in the Field of Ares. Both limp now;
item.description: Alkon #4944 and Melmachos #1305 the Twice-Born fought in the Field of Ares. Both limp now; neither will forget.

item.title: Neoion #699 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered
item.description: Neoion #699 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.description: Eustrato Nichides ~2683 was born in the Field of Ares to Nikion #5172 the Twice-Born and Neogenes #8487, the first Leaf of their line.

item.title: Kleides #893 of the House of Hyperenor fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meado
item.description: Kleides #893 of the House of Hyperenor fell (plague). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.title: Antimnikos #7684 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to
item.description: Antimnikos #7684 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Phaidgenes #3325 the Twice-Born carved Polion #4860's name into a rib-bone and gave it awa
item.description: Phaidgenes #3325 the Twice-Born carved Polion #4860's name into a rib-bone and gave it away. They walk together at dusk now.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Neoippos #6986 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Neoippos #6986 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares. Neoippos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.title: A child for the Gorgonides: Osteope Peisidides ~2544, born to Peisides #7206 and Lyslaos #
item.description: A child for the Gorgonides: Osteope Peisidides ~2544, born to Peisides #7206 and Lyslaos #7881. It will grow old; its parents will not.
